name: ELYSIA // CELESTIAL ORIGIN
title: PRISTINE GODDESS // CRYSTAL REVERIE
quote: Hi~ Did you miss me? Every maiden was born to bring wonder to this world.
lore: The prototype celestial archetype of the MAIDEN series. Woven from harmonic crystal resonance and pure divine intent. Radiates an unyielding field of optimism, restoring squad morale and transmuting destructive energy into scintillating starlight.

abilities.name: Prism Bloom Sanctuary
abilities.desc: Creates a shimmering dome of crystalline light, granting squad invulnerability for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Arrow of Pure Reverie
abilities.desc: Fires superluminal photon arrow that pierces spatial barriers and heals allied systems.

abilities.name: Infinite Flirtation Pulse
abilities.desc: Subdues hostile combat algorithms, inducing sensory recalibration across all enemy units.
